rows.description: TE Standard Edge .050 card-edge socket, SMT, {N} contacts, PCI 5 V (1761842)
rows.note: TE drawing 1761842 (customer drawing, rev C), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/1761842.pdf, sheet 2 RECOMMENDED PC BOARD PATTERN (connector side shown). Per row 11 contacts (10 spaces at 1.27), a key gap of 3.81 (1.91 + 1.91 either side of the mounting hole), 49 contacts (48 spaces at 1.27): 12.7 + 3.81 + 60.96. Mounting holes dia 2.44 at the key and 64.77 (printed) from it; housing 84.84 x 8.89 (sheet 1). The sheet draws the right hole 67 mm away but prints 64.77, which agrees with the housing length 2.54 shorter than 5145098. Pads 0.76 x 2.67 (.030 x .105 printed), pitch 1.27, rows at +-4.32 from the mounting-hole line (4.32 [.170] printed 2 PLC), dia 2.44 mounting holes (non-plated assumed: plating is not stated). Pin numbering ASSUMED (not printed on this print): pin 1 at the right end of the lower row, pins 1..N/2 in the lower row (y>0) right to left, then the upper row right to left, as the printed PIN 1 / PIN 60 / PIN 61 / PIN 120 views of the sibling through-hole print 5145154. Origin: the pad span centre, taken as the housing centre (housing length from sheet 1, centred on the pads: ASSUMPTION, the printed margins differ slightly).

rows.description: TE Standard Edge .050 card-edge socket, through hole, {N} contacts, PCI (5145154)
rows.note: TE drawing 5145154 (customer drawing, rev F), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/5145154.pdf, sheet 2 RECOMMENDED CONNECTOR MOUNTING HOLE PATTERN (connector side shown). Per row 11 contacts (10 spaces at 1.27), key gap 3.81 (1.91 either side of the mounting hole), 49 contacts (48 spaces); second mounting hole 64.77 (printed) from the first; housing 84.84 x 8.89 (sheet 1). The select-loaded variant of sheets 3/4 (pins 44..49 and 104..109 not loaded) is not drawn: the full 120-pin pattern is used. Through-hole tails: holes dia 1.02 (0.040 printed) staggered on 4 hole rows at +-1.27 and +-3.81 from the mounting-hole line (3.81, 1.27 printed 2 PLC), 2.54 pitch per hole row (adjacent contacts alternate between the two hole rows of their side); land diameter NOT PRINTED: 1.3 assumed (the contact next to a mounting hole is 1.905 from its centre, so a land of 1.52 would overlap the 2.44 hole). Dia 2.44 mounting holes non-plated (plating not stated). Pin numbering ASSUMED as for the PIN 1 / PIN 60 / PIN 61 / PIN 120 views of print 5145154: pin 1 at the right end of the lower row, pins 1..N/2 in the lower row (y>0) right to left, then the upper row; the stagger phase follows the hole pattern (first contact after a mounting hole on the outer-for-upper / inner-for-lower hole row). Origin: the pad span centre = housing centre (ASSUMED).
